item: the boot compares the article and full-text counts
summary: OPEN_QUEUE 2026-10-27 item 9 (R412): ensure_fts's auto path counts articles (covering index, 0.24-0.33 s cold at 1 M) and article_fts_docsize once per boot and rebuilds when they differ, so a missing head, a hole, a missing tail or an orphan document is healed at boot; a healthy store, empty texts included, counts equal and is never rebuilt. Items 8 and 15 closed as R412's stated limits.
